content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I am currently using a [product_name] with [article_no]. Unfortunately, a short circuit occurred during use, causing the device to shut off immediately. After waiting a while, I switched it back on—the display seemed okay at first, but none of the arrow or other keys responded. When I tried restarting it again, the display showed only an orange backlight and no characters, although the device still functions otherwise. I am able to connect and transfer programs online without issues. Since this is a brand new unit, I would appreciate any advice on resolving this issue. Would performing a factory reset help, and if so, what are the steps? Thank you in advance.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered a hardware malfunction on a [product_name] after a short circuit, which led to display and key responsiveness issues. Despite these problems, device connectivity and programming capabilities remain unaffected. The user is concerned about the product's durability and is looking for effective recovery or troubleshooting options to restore normal operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the device should withstand faults or be easily recoverable through straightforward reset instructions, especially since it is new. Clear and accessible troubleshooting guidance is expected to address and resolve hardware-related issues promptly.
